name: Negaeba Kitto...
source:
Negaeba Kitto tells the story of a young man who has recently been treated for a serious illness, and who finds a certain kind of redemption in the most unlikely place.

[From [url=http://altogether.insani.org/2008/1.html]al|together 2008[/url]]
translation:
《愿えばきっと…》讲述了一名年轻男子的故事。他不久前刚刚治愈一场重病，却在最意想不到的地方找到了某种救赎。

[摘自[url=http://altogether.insani.org/2008/1.html]al|together 2008[/url]]
